key_points: Morgan Stanley reaffirmed Overweight rating on Gilead, highlighting HIV prevention franchise.
Gilead expanded royalty-free voluntary licensing of lenacapavir to 120 high-incidence countries.
Agreement with Pan American Health Organization to widen access to twice-yearly lenacapavir in Latin America and Caribbean.
Expanded access could drive uptake of lenacapavir, supporting long-term HIV prevention revenue.
No negative headlines; overall sentiment positive for GILD.
